**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement imposes no minimum purchase or volume commitment on Clear Capital:

- **§1(a) (p0004)** — Services are retained "on a task by task basis," with each engagement defined by a separately agreed Statement of Work; there is no guaranteed volume of Services.
- **§3(a) (p0013)** — Compensation is "as set forth in each Statement of Work" on a "time and materials" basis, i.e., only for ordered/performed work.
- **§6 (p0032–p0033)** — Either party may terminate for any or no reason on 15 days' notice when no SOW is outstanding, and on termination Contractor is paid only amounts "incurred or earned... through the effective date of such termination" — no shortfall, penalty or unamortized commitment payment.

Targeted searches for "minimum," "shortfall," "take or pay," "volume," "retainer," "guaranteed," "non-cancelable" and "prepaid" returned nothing responsive, and §3 contains no retainer or committed-hours mechanic.

This sits at the **preferred** position, so no edit is proposed. Noted for the record only (outside this rule): §3(b) lets Contractor change rates on 30 days' notice, which we would ordinarily address under a pricing/rate-increase rule rather than MINCOMMIT.
